title: GraphRAG 복합 다중필드 연계 검색 (aiap3 스타일)

Medical AI 탭: medical-vlm 카테고리 +4모델, radiology-reporting +LePaX, 2026 프론티어/멀티모달 벤치 suite 2종 추가. 리더보드 조사: MedArena/MedHELM-Q2는 aggregator-verify(신뢰 낮음)·MedArena 라이브 미렌더로 미수집, ReXrank V2.0만 primary-read(특화 RRG 시스템). graphrag 재생성.

title: S212g-b — CXRMate-2 PDF 재검증: CheXpert Plus + ReXgradient 데이터셋 보완
detail: CXRMate-2 논문 재검증 결과 초기 수집에서 Table 2의 CheXpert Plus(n=62)·ReXgradient(n=10000) 데이터셋 결과가 누락됐음(cross-dataset 일반화는 논문 핵심 기여). 두 데이터셋 × 9 RRG 메트릭을 CXRMate-2 + DB 기존 baseline(MAIRA-2[CheXpert만]·MedGemma 4B·MedVersa·MedGemma 1.5 4B)에 대해 보완 — 신규 벤치 18종, 81 scores. CXRMate-2가 양 데이터셋 SOTA(ReXgradient GREEN 58.1/RadGraph-XL 41.7, CheXpert Plus GREEN 32.7/RadGraph-XL 30.4). CXRMate-2 총 27 scores(3데이터셋×9). Medical AI 탭에 CheXpert Plus·ReXgradient RRG suite 2종 추가(총 3 RRG suite). graphrag.json 재생성.

title: S212g — CXRMate-2 (CSIRO AEHRC) 흉부 X-ray 리포트생성 SOTA 신규
detail: CXRMate-2(arXiv 2604.18967v2, CSIRO AEHRC) 신규 수집: GRPO RL + structured multimodal temporal embeddings 기반 CXR 리포트생성(RRG) SOTA. RAD-DINO 인코더, 3B, apache-2.0, open-weight. Table 2 MIMIC-CXR(findings, n=1624) 9메트릭(RaTEScore/GREEN/RadEval-BERTScore/RadGraph-XL/CheXbert-F1/CXR-BERT/BERTScore/BLEU-4/ROUGE-L)을 CXRMate-2 + DB 기존 baseline 4종(MedGemma 1.5/4B, MedVersa, MAIRA-2)에 대해 수집(45 scores, 신규 벤치 9종). RRG-특화 연구 메트릭을 단일 primary source가 균일 프로토콜로 평가한 leaderboard형이라 baseline 포함(표준벤치 competitor 스킵과 구분). CXRMate-2 GREEN 46.6/RadGraph-XL 40.3 SOTA(vs MedGemma 1.5 +11.2%/+24.4%). DB 미존재 baseline(EMNLI/CXRMate-ED/Libra/MLRG/PriorRG/DeepMedix-R1) 및 2차 데이터셋(CheXpert Plus/ReXgradient) 미수집(proliferation 방지). Medical AI 탭 radiology-reporting 카테고리 + 신규 MIMIC-CXR RRG suite 추가. 논문 PDF resource/ 저장 + seed_sources·Resources 등록.

title: S212f — Kakao Kanana 2 SLM (1.3B/3B, base+instruct) 신규 4모델
detail: Kakao Kanana 2 소형 LLM 4종 신규 수집(2026-07-27, Kanana License, 32k ctx, Qwen3-backbone 3:1 SWA/full-attention hybrid, Kakao 유저데이터 미사용). base 14벤치 + instruct 16벤치 = 60 scores. HF 카드 5개 링크(tech blog + 4 HF). 신규 벤치 7종: KoSimpleQA(ko_simpleqa)·MATH-Ko(math_ko)·MBPP-Ko(mbpp_ko)·RULER-32K(ruler_32k)·IHEval(iheval)·KMMLU-CoT(kmmlu_cot)·HAERAE-CoT(haerae_cot). CoT 한국어 변종은 plain과 별도 ID(기존 mmlu vs mmlu_cot 관례). Qwen3-1.7B/Qwen3.5-2B baseline 컬럼은 2차 출처라 미수집. Sovereign Korea 리전에 4모델 추가 + korean suite에 신규 한국어 벤치 5종·note 갱신 + KNOWN_PARAMS(1.3/3B)·RELEASE_DATES 반영. <30B라 frontier 제외. tech blog seed_sources·Resources 등록.

title: Overview 카테고리 분류 URL 상태 인코딩 (공유 가능)
detail: Overview 메뉴의 SOTA 카테고리 분류 선택을 URL 해시에 인코딩. 카테고리 pill 선택 시 #overview?cat=<category>, 그룹(A–D/E–H 등) 선택 시 &grp=<group> 추가(기본값 top/All은 생략해 bare #overview로 축소). 해당 URL로 재접속 시 카테고리 필터·그룹·테이블 상태가 그대로 복원됨(_syncOverviewHash/_applyOverviewHash, replaceState라 hashchange 미발생). Leaderboard의 #leaderboard?cat=... 해시 패턴과 일관. 공유·북마크 가능.

title: S212e — Timeline 출시일 검증·보정 (frontier 8건)
detail: Timeline frontier 모델 158개 출시일 검증. 명백한 오류 5건 수정: STUB(2026-01-01/2025-01-01) 3건 — gpt-5.4-high→2026-03-05, gpt-5.5-codex→2026-04-23, gemini-3.1-deep-think→2026-02-19(각 base 모델 출시일 정렬); NULL 2건 — o3-pro→2025-06-10, deepseek-v3.2-exp→2025-09-29. 추가 정밀화 3건(YYYY-MM→일자, effort/thinking 변종은 base와 동시출시): gpt-5.4-medium→2026-03-05, gpt-5.4-mini-high→2026-03-17, claude-3.7-sonnet-thinking→2025-02-24. 일부 이름도 정리(GPT-5.5-Codex, Gemini 3.1 Deep Think, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp). 나머지 21개 YYYY-MM 부분날짜(preview/beta/research artifact)는 crisp GA일이 없어 월 단위 유지(day 조작 금지). metadata_fix 파일로 durable 반영.

detail: 모델 간 연관성을 모달 'Lineage' 섹션에 표시(config/model_enrichment.yaml). MAI-Cyber-1-Flash→base MAI-Code-1-Flash(fine-tune, MAI-Thinking-1 계보, MDASH 구성요소), MAI-Code-1-Flash(MAI-Thinking-1 계보·Frontier Tuning), MDASH(100+ agent 하네스; MAI-Cyber-1-Flash+GPT-5.4 구성). MDASH cybergym 96.55% 값 보존하며 note에 '88.4→95.95%(MAI-Cyber-1+GPT-5.4가 80% 교체 시, 카드 2026-07-27); 96.55% MS Build 2026 Defender' 병기. CyberGym 95.95%는 여전히 시스템 점수로 MDASH에만 귀속(단일 모델 아님).

title: S212d — Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber V8 취약점 발견 결과 수집
detail: Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber(google/gemini-3.5-flash-cyber)는 S197에서 CyberGym 수치 부재로 스코어 0개 stub였음. DeepMind 공식 블로그 1차 재검증 결과 깨끗한 수치 1종 확보: V8 JavaScript 엔진 고유 confirmed 취약점 — 3.5 Flash Cyber 55개(vs mainline 3.5 Flash 47, Opus 4.6 36; 10개는 타 모델 미발견). 신규 벤치 v8_confirmed_vulns_google 등록, cyber-coding 탭 노출, 모델 lineage(base=gemini-3.5-flash) 추가. 미수집: CyberGym(본문 수치 없음+CodeMender 5-call 시스템; 2차 83.2%는 차트/시스템값), Big Sleep pass@1(본문 정성적, 차트만). DeepMind 블로그 seed_sources·Resources 등록.

title: S212b — MAI PDF 재검증: MAI-Code-1-Flash 파라미터/컨텍스트 보강
detail: 사용자 요청으로 두 PDF(MAI-Cyber-1-Flash 카드·MAI-Thinking-1 109p 리포트) 표·내용 전수 재검증. MAI-Thinking-1: Table 11(STEM/coding 8종)·Table 12(knowledge/IF/safety/honesty/health 14종) 완전 대조 — 기존 38개 점수가 전부 커버, net-new 0. Table 14(인간 side-by-side 선호도: vs Sonnet 4.6 승49/무6/패45, vs Opus 4.6 승43/무5/패52)는 pairwise 델타([-1.5,1.5])라 절대 스케일 없음 → 리더보드 오해 방지 위해 미수집(Agent Arena 스킵과 동일 원칙). 경쟁 모델 baseline 컬럼은 각 모델 카드 인용(2차)→미수집. 발견한 보강: MAI-Cyber 카드가 '137B total/5B active/256k, MAI-Code-1-Flash fine-tune' 명시 → fine-tune은 아키텍처 보존이므로 MAI-Code-1-Flash도 137B-A5B/256k. 기존 불완전 params '5B (agentic)'·누락 context를 보정(다른 필드·16 scores 보존).

title: S212 — Microsoft MAI-Cyber-1-Flash 신규 모델 + 외부 사이버 벤치 5종
detail: Microsoft MAI-Cyber-1-Flash(2026-07-27) 모델 카드·뉴스·모델 페이지 분석. 신규 모델 등록: MAI-Code-1-Flash의 사이버 특화 fine-tune(137B total/5B active MoE, 256k ctx, MAI-Thinking-1 계보), proprietary·Azure AI Foundry Private Preview(dual-use 접근 제한). Model-Only External Cyber Benchmark(단일 모델, terminal harness) 5종 수집: CVEBench 31.4%, CyberSecEval4 Threat-Intel 55.3% / Malware-Analysis 33.0%, CRSBench 65.1%(POV=1200), ExploitGym 0%(Kernel/Userspace/Browser 전부 0 — security-first 방어형 보정). 카드 fraction은 기존 cvebench/exploitgym %-스케일에 맞춰 x100 저장. CyberGym 88.4→95.95%는 MDASH 시스템(100+ agents + MAI-Cyber-1-Flash + GPT-5.4) 점수라 단일 모델 귀속 불가 → strict-attribution상 제외. CyberSecEval4 Threat-Intel/Malware-Analysis·CRSBench 3종은 신규 벤치로 등록하고 cyber-coding 탭 CYBER_BENCHMARKS에 노출. MAI-Thinking-1(109p 리포트 Table 11/12) 재검증: 기존 38개 점수가 리포트 전 벤치 커버 → net-new 없음. 모델 카드·테크리포트 PDF resource/ 저장 + Resources 탭·seed_sources 등록.

title: S211b — 타 모델 in-house 스킵분 반영: Opus 5 AI-R&D 벤치 포착
detail: S211 capture-quarantine-audit를 다른 모델의 과거 in-house 스킵분에 적용. 분석 결과 대부분의 과거 '2차 미수집'은 표준 공개 벤치의 baseline 컬럼(각 모델 자체 카드에서 소싱하는 게 맞음, in-house 아님)이거나 safety-adversarial eval(SHADE-Arena/LinuxArena·bio preparedness)이라 capability in-house가 아님. 명확한 in-house capability 스킵=Claude Opus 5 §2.3.5 task-based AI-R&D(Anthropic-internal, Opus 4.7/Mythos 5/Opus 5 비교표) — S206c에서 'niche RSP·speedup 단위'로 스킵했던 것을 category='in-house'로 포착(kernel_task_speedup 기존+Opus값, time_series_forecasting·llm_training_speedup 신규). in-house 벤치 13→15. watchlist 갱신.

detail: in-house/단일-벤더 벤치를 '스킵'하지 않고 '포착·격리·주기검증'하는 워크플로 도입. (1) 포착: Kimi K3 Table 3 in-house 벤치 13종(ClawBench·MIRA·KAET·CLIF·Agentic Vision·Swarm·Online Exp·Deep Research·Finance·KWV·Agent Behavior·Faithfulness·Chat All-in-One)을 category='in-house' 마커로 수집, Table 3 비교값(5-6모델, Kimi-measured single-source, provenance 명시) 67 scores 보존 — 손실 0. (2) 격리: frontier-compare/sovereign은 벤치 id 화이트리스트라 in-house 마커 벤치가 자동 제외(헤드라인 clutter 0). (3) 감사: scripts/benchmark_watchlist.py 신설 — category='in-house'(13) + single-model(1386) 벤치를 리포트(data/export/reports/benchmark_watchlist.json)로 나열해 매 세션 검증(독립 2차 출처 생기면 promote). ExploitBench(cyber)는 metric 미확정이라 watchlist-only. Kimi K3 표시 점수 60→73.

detail: 테크리포트 재점검(전 47p): Tables 1-5가 전부이며 벤치 테이블(2-5)은 S210에서 커버 완료. 누락 발견=메타데이터 오류. Table 1(아키텍처 명세)에 따라 kimi-k3 파라미터 '2.8T-A~50B'→'2.78T-A104B'(total 2.78T/activated 104.2B, 기존 activated ~50B는 오류), type 'open'→'open-weight'(공식 weights 공개), modalities +video(MoonViT-V2 native multimodal, Video-MME/MMVU 보유). 93 layers, Hybrid KDA-MLA(69 KDA+24 MLA), 896 routed experts/16 active, 1M ctx 확인. 나머지 페이지(§7 case studies: GPU kernel/chip design 등)엔 표준 벤치 점수 테이블 없음.

(2) 'frontier=대형 플래그십' 기준 정합화 — 30B 미만(dense/total) 41개 라인 제거(dictalm-3.0, phi-4/mini, tiny-aya, gemma-4 소형, kanana-1.5, motif-2-12.7b, deepseek-r1-distill, olmo-2, nemotron-nano, qwen3.6-27b 등). title: >1T 파라미터 모델 타임라인 표시 + DB 메타데이터(날짜·파라미터) 교정
detail: 문제: Kimi K3(2.8T), Ring/Ling-2.6-1T 등 1T 초과 모델의 파라미터가 Sovereign 출시 타임라인에 표시 안 됨. 원인 3가지: (1) _extractParamsB 정규식이 B(십억)만 파싱하고 T(조)는 무시, (2) 호출부가 DB parameters 문자열을 아예 참조 안 하고 model.name만 사용, (3) KNOWN_PARAMS 누락. 수정: 파서를 T 단위(2.8T->2800) + DB parameters 문자열 파싱으로 확장(MoE 총 파라미터=최댓값 채택; "Tri-70B"의 T 오탐 방지 검증), 호출부에 model.parameters 전달, KNOWN_PARAMS에 kimi-k3=2800 등 >1T 플래그십 추가. 결과: K3가 타임라인 y=2800B 정위치 표시(기존 미공개 하단행). 추가로 사용자 요청에 따라 DB 소스 메타데이터 교정: 43개 모델의 stale/placeholder release_date(None, 2026-01-01, 비-ISO Q*)를 curated 값으로, 50개 open-weight 모델의 누락 parameters를 KNOWN_PARAMS로 채움(프로퍼라이어터리 미공개 추정값은 정직성 위해 DB 미기입). 전체 레코드 병합 재선언으로 타 필드 보존; 파일명 130-z로 로드 최후순 보장(repo의 release_dates_v2 관례 따름). Qwen은 공개 최대 ~480B이고 Max/Plus는 미공개라 >1T Qwen 데이터는 존재하지 않음(사용자 언급 Qwen 3.8은 DB에 없음).

title: Sovereign AI — 국가별 리더보드 경쟁력 & 추이 섹션 추가
detail: Sovereign AI 탭에 각 국가의 최고 성적 모델이 주요 리더보드/아레나/지수에서 프론티어(글로벌 1위) 대비 어디까지 왔고 시간에 따라 어떻게 변하는지 보여주는 섹션 추가. 60개 일별 score-history 스냅샷(2026-04~07)으로 국가별 top-model 시계열을 계산. OpenRouter(사용량 랭킹)·Stanford AI Index(연간 리포트)·HF Open LLM(아카이브)은 per-model 라이브 점수 부재로 제외(각주 명시). 시리즈 계산은 (bench,mode) 캐시 — 탭 재렌더 331ms, O(N^2) 없음.

title: Explorer 비교 조건을 모두 URL로 인코딩 — 공유·북마크 가능한 딥링크

Compare 버튼·체크박스 토글·딥링크 3경로 모두 동일한 _explorerHash()/_updateExplorerHash() 헬퍼로 URL 동기화. 브라우저 실측: ?shared=1 로드 시 체크+12 공통행 복원, 해제 시 URL에서 플래그 제거+226행, 재체크 복원 모두 확인.

title: Session 187 — tab-render perf: kill O(N²) score scans in the 4 chart-heavy tabs (9-18s -> ~0.2s, up to 77x)
detail: Profiled the slow tabs (scores warm/cached, so pure render cost) and found the real bottleneck was NOT data loading but O(N²) linear scans in the render code that ignored the shared score index. Measured cold-render (Playwright): sovereign 17.8s, medical-ai 11.2s, cyber-coding 10.9s, physical-ai 9.5s; ai4s/image/video already <0.15s. Root cause: helper functions doing this._scores.find(...) (linear scan of ~18K scores) called ~280K times per render (Sovereign _getScore alone = 8.6s / 97% of render). Also cyber-coding: inline .some() score scans, .find() over ~4K benchmarks / ~4.7K models inside sort comparators, and a per-suite full-scores rescan with indexOf. Fixes: (1) _getScore in sovereign/physical-ai/medical-ai now uses App.getScoreIndex().byModelBench[mid|bid] (O(1)); (2) cyber-coding +_scoreEntry/_benchById/_modelById O(1) helpers (id->object maps built once per init), replaced all inline .find/.some scans + the per-suite scoreLookup build. Results (Playwright, warm): **sovereign 17,811->230ms (77x), medical-ai 11,150->218ms (51x), cyber-coding 10,880->289ms (38x), physical-ai 9,677->186ms (52x)**. Output identical (row/canvas counts unchanged: sovereign 226 rows/5 charts, medical 540/9, cyber 651/5, physical 331/10); JS unit tests pass. Note: image-gen/video-gen/ai4s were never slow at render — their perceived slowness was the first shared current.json parse (addressed by S186's lean split). No data changes; 4 JS files.

title: Session 186 — loading-speed: JS minify at deploy + lean scores/current.json (35% smaller) + scheduled-workflow fixes
detail: Two dashboard load-speed improvements + fixed the month-long scheduled-workflow failures. **(1) JS minify at deploy** — added esbuild minify step to the Publish job (benchmark-update.yml) that minifies the STAGED public/js in place (~42% smaller: 1639 KB -> 956 KB across 26 files); source tree stays readable, filenames unchanged so index.html/cache-bust untouched. package.json +esbuild devDep + scripts/minify-dashboard-js.mjs. **(2) Lean scores payload** — split scores/current.json: the boot-critical shared index + Explorer table/filters only need model_id/benchmark_id/value/unit/is_sota + source.type/date + collected_at, so the heavy click-time-only fields (source.url ~35% + notes ~23%) moved to an INDEX-ALIGNED sidecar scores/current_meta.json fetched lazily and merged back onto the score objects in place. current.json 6.6 MB -> 4.47 MB (32% smaller first-scores-tab load); 2.24 MB sidecar now lazy. All existing consumers (modals, Explorer, history) read s.source.url / s.notes unchanged — verified end-to-end via Playwright (17,745 scores load, sidecar merge restores arxiv URLs + notes, source modal renders 'Source URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/...'). App._ensureScoreMeta() (cached, background-kicked after scores + ensured on modal open). **(3) Scheduled-workflow fixes** (Discovery Agent + Librarian Weekly failing every run since ~2026-06-20): three chained root causes fixed + verified passing — Python 3.9->3.11 (pyproject requires >=3.11, pip install failed; main), seed_sources.yaml 27x invalid `\$`->`$` YAML escapes (yaml.safe_load crashed the agents; ops), and librarian missing permissions:contents:write (git push 403; main). Both workflows now green on manual re-trigger. Note: dashboard already lazy-loads current.json/graphrag.json(8.5MB)/tab-JS/echarts, so these target the remaining hot spots.

title: Session 174 — Microsoft HealthAgentBench (arxiv 2606.31179) — 8 benches, 64 scores, GPT-5.5 42% #1
detail: Microsoft Research released HealthAgentBench on 2026-06-30. 54 agentic healthcare tasks × 3 attempts (162 trials total) across 7 executable environment categories (X-ray Report Correction / CT Abnormality Classification / Pathology Tumor Area Selection / Clinical Trial Matching / EHR Data Quality Audit / EHR Event Modelling / EHR Format Conversion) spanning 5 modalities (text, EHR, 2D X-ray, 3D CT, gigapixel WSI). Metric = binary task success rate pooled over 3 attempts. Zero new backbone models — all 10 tested (gpt-5.5/5.4/5.4-mini/5.3, opus-4.8/4.7/4.6, sonnet-4.6) already in DB. **OVERALL LEADERBOARD**: Codex+GPT-5.5 42% #1, Copilot+Opus-4.8 36 #2, Copilot+GPT-5.5 35 #3, ClaudeCode+Opus-4.8 32 #4, Codex+GPT-5.4 28 #5, Codex+Opus-4.7 27, ClaudeCode+Sonnet-4.6 17. **BURIED FINDINGS**: (1) GPT-5.4 BEATS GPT-5.5 on X-ray Report Correction (40 vs 33) — flagship regression on medical vision. (2) Claude Opus 4.6 leads EHR Data Quality Audit at 42, beating both GPT-5.5 (25) and its own successor Opus 4.8 (33) — older Opus wins healthcare data literacy. (3) Opus 4.7 leads EHR Event Modelling at 78 vs GPT-5.5 72 — clinical event modeling favors Claude reasoning. (4) Opus 4.6 UNIQUELY FAILS MEDS Format Conversion (0% while every other agent scores 100%) — specific format-handling collapse. (5) Opus 4.6 fails 3D CT entirely (0%) and Sonnet 4.6 only 3% — Claude 4.6 tier has vision-modality-specific weakness. (6) HARNESS EFFECT: GPT-5.5 drops 42→35 (Codex→Copilot CLI); Opus-4.8 improves 32→36 (Claude Code→Copilot CLI) — infrastructure ±7pt matters more than backbone choice. Loaded 8 benches (1 overall + 7 sub-category), 64 scores (dedup: 66 raw → 64 via MAX-per-harness-variant, notes preserve full variance). Propagated to Medical AI tab as new suite 🤖 Agentic Healthcare Tasks, Frontier Compare agent category +healthagentbench. Data access is gated (PhysioNet / HF-gated / Redivis). No aggregate human/expert baseline in paper (only per-category count+GBM baseline for EHR Event Modelling).

title: Session 173 — Changelog display broken (schema drift + missing typeOrder + 5 missing S169-S172 entries)
detail: User asked why the changelog looked broken. Three separate bugs compounding: (1) TYPE REGISTRY INCOMPLETE — since S155 the session logs use lowercase 'session' + 'ingest' types, but typeOrder + typeColors in renderChangelog() only knew the legacy uppercase types (Feature, Data, Fix, PDF Analysis, Web Collection, SOTA, etc.). Auto-append kept the entries alive but placed them at the end of the list with default gray 'Other' coloring — users saw ancient S67 'Feature' entries at top and current sessions buried below. (2) RENDERER USED SOTA-SCHEMA ONLY — the render code did `title.textContent = change.benchmark_id` which returns undefined for session-type entries. Those entries carry `{title, detail}` shape instead of `{benchmark_id, new_model, new_value}`. Result: session cards showed just the date badge with completely empty content lines. (3) MISSING ENTRIES — S169 (Explorer fix), S169b (Overview + deep-link modals), S170 (final orphan sweep), S171 (Claude+OpenAI dedup), S172 (durable ingest map) were never added to changelog.json. Fixes committed in 5329ab8 + 7692f24: added 'session' + 'ingest' to typeOrder (first two entries so recent work surfaces on top) + colors (blue + cyan) + typeLabels map for Title Case section headings; renderer now uses `change.title || change.benchmark_id` with detail text rendered as smaller collapsed second line (leading-relaxed text-xs text-gray-500); prepended 5 missing changelog entries. Live verified: Session (32) → Ingest (20) → Feature (4) → Data (15) section order, S172 entry shows full 'Durable dedup via ingest-time canonical map (fixes recurring dupe regression)' title + detail paragraph. Related memory rule: 'Changelog UI typeOrder must be exhaustive — auto-append + group-internal date desc sort required.' This commit brings us back in compliance with the rule.

title: Session 172 — Durable dedup via ingest-time canonical map (fixes recurring dupe regression)
detail: Root cause of the 'claude-fable-5 keeps coming back on live site' bug. SQL migrations S163-S171 only touched data/benchmark.db. The daily CI workflow's analyst job runs load_benchmark_scores.py which re-reads all 60+ resource/zzz_*_scores*.json files on every deploy. Multiple resource files contain the exact prefix-less or dash-form IDs (claude-fable-5, gpt-5-2-high, qwen3-7-max, anthropic/claude-sonnet-3.7 etc.) that had been merged, so every deploy silently re-inserted them via INSERT OR REPLACE. The dedup was reversed on every deploy. FIX: Extracted all 163 (dupe → canonical) pairs from S163-S171 migration SQL files into new data/model_canonical_map.json (git-committed). load_benchmark_scores.py now calls canonicalize(model_id) at BOTH model row insert AND score row insert. Model INSERTs skip if the canonical already exists (canonical wins). Score INSERTs land under the canonical model_id even when the source JSON used the dupe form. Verification cycle: restored DB from pre-s171.bak, re-applied S171 migration, ran full load_benchmark_scores.py pass — before re-load: only anthropic/claude-fable-5 + -max present; after re-load with new canonicalization: same, no re-introduction. Post-deploy live verification confirmed: claude-fable-5, gpt-5-2-high, qwen3-7-max, gpt-4-1, claude-sonnet-3.7 all absent from live models.json. Every future deploy (cron, workflow_dispatch, repository_dispatch) now produces canonical output. Adding new dupes to data/model_canonical_map.json is the one-line action to keep dedup healthy going forward. Follow-up (optional): rewrite resource/*_scores*.json to use canonical IDs at source; the ingest-time normalizer makes this cleanup optional rather than blocking.

title: Session 169b — Overview Recent Data Feed + deep-link modals show empty on cold load
detail: Follow-up audit after S169 Explorer fix surfaced two more instances of the same bug pattern. Overview's _renderRecentDataFeed widget iterates App.data.scores to compute 'Last 7 days: N models received new scores'. Overview is the DEFAULT landing tab and not in SCORE_DEPENDENT, so the widget stayed at '0 models received new scores' until user navigated away and back. Also #model/, #bench/, #vendor/ deep-link modals all call Modal.showX(id) after setTimeout(300ms). Modal.showModel/showBenchmark/showVendor all read App.data.scores at open time — cold-load URL pastes rendered empty benchmark lists. Three fixes in one commit (174f6fb): (1) Fire self._ensureScores() at the end of loadData() as fire-and-forget so scores start downloading right after critical-path data lands. (2) Inside _ensureScores().then, re-render Overview if it's the currently active tab so the Recent Data Feed refreshes with real counts. (3) Wrap the three deep-link handlers in _ensureScores().then(...) before opening the modal. Verified live: Overview cold load now shows 'Auto-computed from data: 69 new models · 1842 models received new scores' (was 0 before).

title: Session 169 — Explorer tab: models selected + Compare clicked → empty results
detail: User reported that selecting two models in Explorer tab and clicking Compare produced no output. Root cause: Explorer.compare() reads App.data.scores at compare-button click time. But 'explorer' was missing from the SCORE_DEPENDENT map in app.js that gates _ensureScores(). Cold-load tab click ran against scores = [] and produced an empty comparison table + blank radar chart. Bug latent since the lazy-load architecture landed (scores fetch was deferred but Explorer's tab entry was never added to SCORE_DEPENDENT). Surfaced now that scores/current.json is 6.4 MB raw and cold-load timing matters. Two fixes in same commit (f83f248): (1) Add explorer:1 to SCORE_DEPENDENT so tab click triggers scores fetch. (2) Wrap the deep-link handler (#explore/mid1,mid2 URL) in _ensureScores().then() so URLs pasted before scores arrive still render correctly. Verified live: Sonnet 5 vs Opus 4.8 comparison now shows 43 shared / 360 total benchmarks, radar with 16 axes.
